mapper.select: select dname, deptno from dept where dname like CONCAT('%',#{search_name},'%') order by deptno

SELECT d.deptno AS deptNo, d.dname AS deptName, s.sabun AS sabun, s.saname AS saname, s.sajob AS sajob FROM dept d LEFT JOIN sawon s ON d.deptno = s.deptno AND s.sastatus = '재직' ORDER BY d.deptno, s.sabun

SELECT id, pid, name, title FROM ( SELECT 'COMPANY' AS id, NULL AS pid, 'CEO' AS name, '본부' AS title UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('DEPT_', deptno), 'COMPANY', dname, '부서' FROM dept UNION ALL SELECT CAST(s.sabun AS CHAR), CONCAT('DEPT_', s.deptno), s.saname, s.sajob FROM sawon s WHERE s.deptno IS NOT NULL AND s.sastatus = '재직' ) AS org_chart
select d.dname, count(s.sabun) cnt from dept d left join sawon s on d.deptno = s.deptno and s.sastatus = '재직' group by d.dname
SELECT d.dname AS deptName, COUNT(s.sabun) AS sawonCount FROM dept d LEFT JOIN sawon s ON d.deptno = s.deptno AND s.sastatus = '재직' GROUP BY d.deptno, d.dname ORDER BY sawonCount DESC
mapper.update: update dept set deptno = #{vo.deptno}, dname = #{vo.dname}, dtel = #{vo.dtel} WHERE deptno = #{ori_deptno}
mapper.select: select * from dept where deptno = #{deptno} and dname = #{dname}
select d.deptno, d.dname, d.dtel, s.sabun, s.saname, s.sajob, s.saemail, s.satel FROM dept d LEFT JOIN sawon s ON d.deptno = s.deptno AND s.sastatus = '재직' ORDER BY d.deptno, s.sabun
